name: emb-repo
description: 嵌入式项目基础：工程默认原则、受管理文件登记约定、项目画像和仓库管理。Embedded foundations: principles, engineering artifact registry conventions, project profile, repo management.

inject_principles.title: 自动注入工程原则 / Inject engineering principles
inject_principles.description: 开启时，在会话开始注入轻量工程原则，在子 Agent 启动时注入一行精简版；关闭后只能通过 /emb-repo:engineering-principles 手动使用。On: inject short principles at session start and a one-line digest for subagents.
